acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Affinity proteomics; Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was specified as a cleavage enzyme allowing up to 2 missed cleavages, 4 modifications per peptide and up to 5 charges.

collision_energy.evidence: Peptides were selected for MS/MS using HCD setting at 30, ion fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 60,000.

enrichment_method.evidence: experiment types: Affinity proteomics; Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

fragmentation_method.evidence: Peptides were selected for MS/MS using HCD setting at 30, ion fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 60,000.

ionization_type.evidence: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) coupled online to the nano-LC.

labeling.evidence: For abundance comparison, abundance ratios were calculated by Label-Free Quantification (LFQ) of the precursor intensities within Proteome Discoverer 2.4 SP1.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Intact peptides were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 120,000.
